name: ARMOR-SIMULATOR
notes: Generates deterministic valid telemetry and health for several scenarios (patrol, crossing, two intruders, empty), the readings of a solar inverter with its battery and of an electrical node, and injects repeatable faults (silent node, out-of-order, duplicates, flapping, and deliberately invalid messages) without needing a broker or hardware. The geometry is illustrative, not a model of the real radar.
